summary: Iteration 7: Validated Recargas de celular module (POST /api/recargas, ticket-pdf, integration with Sales/Caja) and subtle rust-red gradient background in ERP inner area. Backend pytest: 7/7 PASS. Frontend Playwright: all data-testids present, both portal buttons open recargastae.com in new tab, POST /api/recargas returns 200 with tipo_venta=recarga/total/referencia_tae/comision persisted, ticket dialog shows folio, WhatsApp button triggers POST /sales/{id}/ticket-pdf (200) then opens wa.me with prefilled 52+phone, new recarga row appears in 'Recargas de hoy'. Gradient bg-gradient-to-br from-[#8B3A1A]/25 verified on layout wrapper; cards/tables remain white and readable in Dashboard/Clientes.
action_items: Optional cleanup: delete QA test recargas created during this run (referencia_tae LIKE 'QA-%'): folios R000001 (backend curl earlier by main agent), R000002 and R000003 (this iteration). All are tipo_venta='recarga', total 20 or 50, cliente Público General.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::crear_recarga (line 1126) correctly validates monto<=0 and blank telefono returning 400. Sale saved with tipo_venta='recarga', estado='confirmada', persists compania/telefono/referencia_tae/comision and appends caja_movimiento only when caja abierta and metodo='efectivo' — good.
Recargas.jsx opens window.open(TAE_URL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') for both portal buttons. Verified popups navigate to https://recargastae.com/Account/SignIn.aspx.

sendWhatsApp() calls /sales/{id}/ticket-pdf then opens wa.me with 52-prefixed phone when 10 digits — verified end-to-end (popup url started with https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=525544332211 which wa.me redirects to).

ErpLayout.jsx line 82 uses Tailwind arbitrary values bg-gradient-to-br from-[#8B3A1A]/25 via-[#A64621]/12 to-[#F1F5F9] — computed style resolves to linear-gradient(to right bottom, rgba(139,58,26,0.25), rgb(241,245,249)); note the 'via' color is NOT rendered in the computed style (only from/to). Not a bug per se but if a mid stop is expected, consider verifying tailwind JIT picked up all three stops.

Recargas.jsx history filter loads /sales?rango=hoy and filters tipo_venta==='recarga' — works but every load fetches ALL sales for the day; if daily volume grows, consider a dedicated /api/recargas GET endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Created recargas R000002 and R000003 (Telcel · 5544332211, monto $20 and $50, metodo efectivo, comision 2/3, referencia_tae QA-REF-001 / QA-FRONT-02) plus prior R000001 by main agent. All safe (Público General).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration7_recargas.py -v -o addopts='' (pytest.ini adds -n auto which breaks module-scope pytest.<attr> sharing). Use page.expect_response (not wait_for_response) with Playwright sync-over-async wrapper in this env. Portal TAE is external only — do NOT try to test the real recargastae.com site, just assert popup url contains 'recargastae.com'. Wa.me may redirect to api.whatsapp.com/send — accept both.
